## For-loop version — runs until the list is done
No more schedule trigger / Active toggle. Click **Execute Workflow** once and it loops through every unsent row in ONE continuous execution — read once, then send → wait → send → wait ... until nothing unsent is left. This is a real n8n "for loop" via the Loop Over Numbers (Split In Batches) node + a Wait node that loops back to it.

**Pacing:** the Wait node between each send is set to 10 seconds — same rate as before (~360/hr). With 2500 rows this single execution runs for roughly 7 hours. n8n has no execution timeout by default, so it won't get killed partway through — just don't close the n8n container/Docker Desktop while it's running.

**Progress tracking:** still uses n8n's internal static data (sentPhones), NOT the xlsx file — Test.xlsx stays read-only, avoiding the Docker Desktop bind-mount write bug entirely. Re-running this workflow (e.g. after adding more numbers) automatically skips anyone already marked sent.

**Retry behavior:** a failed send is retried on a LATER re-run of the whole workflow (not immediately in this same loop) — after 3 total failures across runs, that number is given up on so it can't block the queue.

**To run it again later** (e.g. you added more numbers to Test.xlsx): just click Execute Workflow again — already-sent numbers are skipped automatically.

**To stop it mid-run:** cancel the execution from n8n's Executions list.

**Docker/open-wa setup (unchanged):** `/files/Test.xlsx` via bind mount; open-wa reached at `http://host.docker.internal:8080/api/messages/sendText`.
